Count sgRNA from FASTQ files using MAGECK

Source: R/count_sgRNA.R
count_sgRNA_mageck.Rd

This function counts sgRNA sequences from FASTQ files using the MAGECK tool. It requires a sample sheet CSV file containing sample information, the sgRNA library to use, and parameters for output directory and file naming.

Usage

count_sgRNA_mageck(
  samplesheet_csv = NULL,
  sgRNA_library = "DTKP",
  mageck_bin = "/Users/sigven/miniconda3/bin/mageck",
  norm_method = "median",
  count_N = FALSE,
  output_dir = NULL,
  output_prefix = "FGFR4",
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

samplesheet_csv

A character string specifying the path to a CSV file containing sample information with mandatory columns: fastq, sample_label, condition.

sgRNA_library

A character string specifying the sgRNA library to use. Must be one of 'ACOC','DTKP','GEEX','MEPR','PROT','TMMO','CHIP1'. Default is "DTKP".

mageck_bin

A character string specifying the path to the MAGECK binary.

norm_method

Method for normalization ('none','median','total') (default is "median").

count_N

A logical indicating whether to count 'N' bases in sgRNA sequences (default is FALSE).

output_dir

A character string specifying the directory where the count results will be saved.

output_prefix

A character string to prefix output files. Default is "FGFR4".

overwrite

A logical indicating whether to overwrite existing output files (default is FALSE).

Value

None. The function performs counting and saves results to files.
